Statistical Profile & Matchup Edge: Through Week 11, Los Angeles ranks #30 in Points / Game (16.8), #25 in Points Allowed / Game (26.6), #26 in Turnover Differential (-5), giving Jim Harbaugh and Chris O'Leary a clear benchmark ahead of Sun, Nov 29, 1:05 PM PST • NFL TV at [object Object] against the New England Patriots [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/recap?gameId=401873074).
